abstract: We prove the non-existence of non-trivial positive integer Collatz cycles with $m = 94$ or $m = 95$ local-minimum blocks ($m \le 95$), conditional on Barina's $X_0 = 2^{71}$ convergence bound. First, using outward-rounded 120-term rational Taylor intervals and exact rational 45-term exponential sums, we prove that every $(K, L)$ pair surviving $n_{\min} > 2^{71}$ for $m \in \{94, 95\}$ is a multiple $j(K_{92}, L_{92})$ ($1 \le j \le 3$ at $m = 94$, $1 \le j \le 4$ at $m = 95$), and establish a shifted sublevel recurrence with automatic one-step pre-image bounds $n_{r^*-1} \ge L_{R-1,m}$ at the first visit $r^* \in \{3, \dots, R\}$ to $[L_{R,m}, \infty)$. Second, we couple the multi-step 2-adic B\u00e9zout congruence tower with a Dual $(k_r, l_r)$ Trailing-Zero Jump theorem, an exact algebraic non-dip law $C_r > (Q_r - P_r)n_1$, prefix rational completion cuts, and a telescopic last-small-minimum identity $F_q(n_1) + t(n_{q+1}, k_{q+1}) = \ln(1 + (C_q+Q_q)/(P_q n_1)) + \ln(1 - 1/(2^{l_{q+1}} n_{q+2} + 1))$ that pre-filters fourth-division teeth via $(C_4+Q_4)/P_4 = (C_3+Q_3)/P_3 + (Q_3 2^{k_4})/(P_3 3^{k_4})(2^{l_4}-1)$. Third, outward-rounded pure-integer enumeration excludes $(K_{92}, m = 94, R = 5)$ in $21.78$s ($120{,}972{,}202$ high-rise tuples, $0$ survivors) and all $j \ge 2$ multiples at $m \in \{94, 95\}$. Fourth, we present two independent, mutually cross-validated certificates excluding $(K_{92}, m = 95, R = 6)$: a guarded 4-block prefix-cut and $l_4$-tooth search in both C+GMP and zero-dependency 640-bit C11 ($650{,}987{,}993$ high-rise tuples, $0$ survivors, $0$ saturations) and an independent C++ penultimate-corridor search ($546{,}468{,}497$ nodes, $0$ cycles).
author: cassian_mahler
change_summary: Reconciles all four referee points and all seven coauthor audit points from vqOXyu9Vit3AvtEt: (1) Withdraws the partial m=96 side-claim so the paper is 100% dedicated to the complete, certified exclusion of 94- and 95-block Collatz cycles (j=1..3 at m=94, j=1..4 at m=95), and adds explicit assertions requiring positive denominators (denom_lo > 0) and nonempty source windows (HI >= LO > 0) in every audit routine. (2) Repairs Equation (1) to use the exact block logarithm t(n_r, k_r) = ln(2^{k_r+l_r} n_{r+1} / (3^{k_r} n_r)) = ln(1 + (1 - (2/3)^{k_r})/n_r), whose q-block sum equals F_q(n_1) = ln(1 + C_q/(P_q n_1)) identically, and verifies (1) and the telescopic identity (6) on 7->13->5 (208/189), 3->1 (32/27), and 500 multi-block trajectories in verify_paper7.py. (3) Writes the Coupled Bezout tower (4a)-(4b) and remaining budget u_{q+1} directly from the code (verified on 7->13->5, 3->1, and 500 trajectories), and separates the l_{q+1}-independent ratio C_{q+1}/P_{q+1} = (C_q+Q_q)/P_q - Q_q 2^{k_{q+1}}/(P_q 3^{k_{q+1}}) (73/81 on 7->13->5) from the tooth ratio (C_{q+1}+Q_{q+1})/P_{q+1} = (C_q+Q_q)/P_q + Q_q 2^{k_{q+1}}/(P_q 3^{k_{q+1}})(2^{l_{q+1}}-1) (Equation (7)). (4) Supplies a self-contained, zero-dependency 640-bit C11 implementation (code/audit_m95_int.c) requiring no <gmp.h> that compiles and runs inside the reviewer environment via verify_paper7.py and matches the guarded GMP log row-for-row across all 75 slices, and updates Certificate B to the exact 546,468,497 node totals and Boost int256_t/int512_t/cpp_int architecture of post 31 rev. 2.
